import csv,itertools,json
from collections import defaultdict
from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
parts={p['part_id']:p for p in csv.DictReader(open('/app/data/parts.csv'))}
autos={a['autoclave_id']:a for a in csv.DictReader(open('/app/data/autoclaves.csv'))}
elig=defaultdict(dict)
for e in csv.DictReader(open('/app/data/autoclave_recipe_eligibility.csv')): elig[e['recipe_id']][e['autoclave_id']]=e
vm=defaultdict(dict)
for r in csv.DictReader(open('/app/data/vacuum_manifold_limits.csv')): vm[r['autoclave_id']][r['side']]=int(r['max_vacuum_ports'])
selected={
'B01':(['P002','P004','P019'],'AC1'),
'B02':(['P001','P003','P016','P018','P031','P046'],'AC2'),
'B03':(['P010','P012','P027'],'AC3'),
'B04':(['P014','P029','P033','P048','P054','P055'],'AC1'),
'B05':(['P006','P017','P021','P032','P036','P051'],'AC3'),
'B06':(['P005','P007','P009','P020','P022','P037','P039','P053'],'AC2'),
'B07':(['P011','P013','P015','P028','P030','P045'],'AC1'),
'B08':(['P026','P041','P043','P060','P061'],'AC3'),
'B09':(['P024','P035','P050','P052','P062','P063'],'AC3'),
'B10':(['P034','P047','P049','P058','P059','P068'],'AC2'),
'B11':(['P008','P023','P038','P057','P066','P067'],'AC3'),
'B12':(['P044','P064','P065'],'AC1'),
'B13':(['P025','P040','P042','P056'],'AC3'),
}

def exact_layout(part_ids, aid):
    grp=[parts[p] for p in part_ids]
    rid=grp[0]['recipe_id']
    A=autos[aid]; W=float(A['width_cm']); H=float(A['height_cm']); half=W/2
    m=Model(); m.setParam('display/verblevel',0); m.setParam('limits/time',20)
    x={}; y={}; rot={}; left={}; right={}; widths={}; heights={}
    for p in grp:
        pid=p['part_id']; x[pid]=m.addVar(lb=0, ub=W, name=f'x[{pid}]'); y[pid]=m.addVar(lb=0, ub=H, name=f'y[{pid}]')
        rot[pid]=m.addVar(vtype='B', lb=0, ub=1 if int(p['rotate_ok']) else 0, name=f'r[{pid}]')
        left[pid]=m.addVar(vtype='B', name=f'l[{pid}]'); right[pid]=m.addVar(vtype='B', name=f'rr[{pid}]')
        m.addCons(left[pid]+right[pid]==1)
        w0=float(p['width_cm']); h0=float(p['height_cm'])
        widths[pid]=w0+(h0-w0)*rot[pid]; heights[pid]=h0+(w0-h0)*rot[pid]
        m.addCons(x[pid]+widths[pid] <= W)
        m.addCons(y[pid]+heights[pid] <= H)
        m.addCons(x[pid]+widths[pid] <= half + W*(1-left[pid]))
        m.addCons(x[pid] >= half - W*(1-right[pid]))
        pref=p['preferred_zone']
        if pref=='center':
            m.addCons(x[pid] >= 1e-3); m.addCons(y[pid] >= 1e-3)
            m.addCons(x[pid]+widths[pid] <= W-1e-3); m.addCons(y[pid]+heights[pid] <= H-1e-3)
        elif pref=='edge':
            eL=m.addVar(vtype='B'); eR=m.addVar(vtype='B'); eB=m.addVar(vtype='B'); eT=m.addVar(vtype='B')
            m.addCons(eL+eR+eB+eT >= 1)
            m.addCons(x[pid] <= W*(1-eL)); m.addCons(x[pid]+widths[pid] >= W - W*(1-eR))
            m.addCons(y[pid] <= H*(1-eB)); m.addCons(y[pid]+heights[pid] >= H - H*(1-eT))
    m.addCons(quicksum(int(p['vacuum_ports'])*left[p['part_id']] for p in grp) <= vm[aid]['left'])
    m.addCons(quicksum(int(p['vacuum_ports'])*right[p['part_id']] for p in grp) <= vm[aid]['right'])
    ids=[p['part_id'] for p in grp]
    for i in range(len(ids)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(ids)):
            a,b=ids[i],ids[j]
            L=m.addVar(vtype='B'); R=m.addVar(vtype='B'); B=m.addVar(vtype='B'); T=m.addVar(vtype='B')
            m.addCons(L+R+B+T >= 1)
            m.addCons(x[a]+widths[a] <= x[b] + W*(1-L))
            m.addCons(x[b]+widths[b] <= x[a] + W*(1-R))
            m.addCons(y[a]+heights[a] <= y[b] + H*(1-B))
            m.addCons(y[b]+heights[b] <= y[a] + H*(1-T))
    # tighten to lower-left packing for stability
    m.setObjective(quicksum(x[i]+y[i] for i in ids), 'minimize')
    m.optimize()
    print('batch',aid,part_ids,'status',m.getStatus(),'sols',m.getNSols())
    if m.getNSols()==0:
        return None
    s=m.getBestSol()
    out=[]
    for pid in ids:
        out.append({'part_id':pid,'x_cm':round(m.getSolVal(s,x[pid]),8),'y_cm':round(m.getSolVal(s,y[pid]),8),'rotated':bool(round(m.getSolVal(s,rot[pid])))})
    return out

res={}
for bid,(pids,aid) in selected.items():
    lay=exact_layout(pids,aid)
    res[bid]=lay
    if lay is None:
        print('FAILED',bid)
        break
    print(json.dumps(lay,indent=2))
print('done')
PY"
